summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K announcing that Adrian de Souza will succeed Tom Clarkson as Company Secretary effective 9 October 2026. The filing is a routine governance disclosure, not a special situation; de Souza is described as an England and Wales-qualified solicitor with over 30 years of legal, governance and company secretarial experience, most recently Group Company Secretary at Standard Chartered plc. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, ownership change or regulatory clock are stated. What to watch: nothing for risk-arb purposes; this is an administrative succession with no deal implications.
